$comment: Labels and explanations for every enum value in problem.schema.json. The validator checks that the two files list the same values, so update both together. Shared by the site, and later the extension and app.

open.label: Open
open.description: Not settled, and open-ended: there is no single agreed statement of what "solved" means yet, so progress is measured in milestones (for example a technology goal or a phenomenon awaiting an explanation).

unsolved.label: Unsolved
unsolved.description: Precisely stated, with a definite answer that nobody has found yet (for example a conjecture with no accepted proof or disproof).

solved.label: Solved
solved.description: Answered as posed: a proof, disproof, construction, algorithm or measurement has been found and accepted.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Closed without an answer as posed: shown impossible, independent of the usual axioms, ill-posed, or superseded by later understanding.

low.label: Low
low.description: A quick AI session is enough: summarizing known results, checking sources or tidying the progress map.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Standard reasoning: working through known arguments, reproducing a calculation or drafting a checkpoint write-up.

high.label: High
high.description: Extended reasoning: long derivations, careful proof or code checking, and comparing many sources.

max.label: Max
max.description: Frontier work: the deepest reasoning settings, long multi-agent research runs, and expert human review of every claim.

work_left.label: Work left
work_left.description: How much work is left before the problem is fully solved.

significance.label: Significance
significance.description: Real-world significance if the problem is fully solved.
significance.high: Would change everyday life or technology

done.label: Done
done.description: Reached and accepted. Build on it instead of redoing it.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.description: Someone is working on this now. Check with them before starting the same work.

not-started.label: Not started
not-started.description: A known next step that nobody has taken yet.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Claimed, but not yet accepted, or contested by others.

dead-end.label: Dead end
dead-end.description: Tried and did not work. Recorded so nobody repeats it without a new idea.
